title: test(console,plugin-list): make two Storage.prototype spy instruments measure what they claim (objectui#7786)
body:
Fixes #7786

Two suites spied on `Storage.prototype` and graded **green without measuring
what their names promised**. They are two *different* defects, so they get two
different repairs — neither of them touches runtime source, `vitest.setup.base.ts`
(PR #7785's surface), or the i18n suite.

## 1. `apps/console/src/__tests__/bootSplash.test.ts` — the injected fault never landed

`it('survives a browser with no localStorage access')` installed
`vi.spyOn(Storage.prototype, 'getItem').mockImplementation(() => { throw … })`
and then asserted `runBootSplash()` does not throw. The spy never reached the
script under test, for two reasons that are both live in this repo:

- happy-dom hands `localStorage` out through a proxy that has **already bound**
  `getItem`, so a prototype patch installed after the store's method was first
  reached is invisible to it;
- `vitest.setup.base.ts` may swap the store for a **plain in-memory object**
  that never inherited from `Storage.prototype` at all.

So the case asserted that an *ordinary* boot does not throw, under a name
promising a blocked browser. **Not** repaired by bolting a probe onto the old
spy (that would go red for the wrong reason — instrument in the wrong place, not
a bug in `runBootSplash`), and **not** by renaming the test down to what it
actually did. Instead the fault is now injected where the script resolves it —
the same property-replacement shape `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/provider-locale-persistence.test.tsx`
already uses against this exact hazard — plus two things it did not have:

- a **counter-probe**: `expect(() => localStorage.getItem(…)).toThrow('storage blocked')`
  *before* anything is graded on the absence of a throw;
- a stored `dark` theme choice, so the expected `light` outcome is reachable
  **only** when storage is genuinely unreadable (previously `light` was also
  what an empty store produced, so the assertion held either way).

The original property descriptor is restored in `finally`, and the test asserts
the store is readable again afterwards.

## 2. `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/UserFilters.addTab.test.tsx` — a negative assertion with no liveness check

The load-bearing line is `expect(setItem).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(0)` — a
**negative** assertion, which a blind instrument satisfies *for the wrong
reason*. This is the counter-probe fix, shaped like the one in
`anonSeedScope-5746.enumeration.test.tsx`: before asserting anything about
writes it did not make, the test now asserts the spy observes writes it makes
itself — in **both** `sessionStorage` and `localStorage`, since a store can be
handed out already bound to its own method and the comment above the spy claims
to cover both. The probe's own writes are then `mockClear()`ed, so the
load-bearing assertion is left verbatim as the claim it always was.

## Readings — every claim below was measured, on Node **v22.22.2** (the version CI pins)

Measured on the tree committed as `ddfecb545`, in a dedicated worktree cut from `origin/main` `6771c805a`. The suites ran on the working tree that was then committed unchanged as that sha; both lit controls ran with it as `HEAD`.

### Suites green (actual counts, not "green")

| run | files | tests |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 apps/console/` | **89 passed (89)** | **981 passed (981)** |
| `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-list/` | **66 passed (66)** | **822 passed (822)** |

The two repaired files carry 15 tests (`bootSplash.test.ts`) and 12
(`UserFilters.addTab.test.tsx`) of those totals.

### ⭐ Lit control E1 — item 1's probe shouts when the fault is injected the old way

The mutation puts the **pre-repair injection point back** (`vi.spyOn(Storage.prototype,
'getItem').mockImplementation(blocked)`) and leaves the new counter-probe in place.

```

E1 mutated blob:   73f3da03a2198af4621bcf63df640ba62affeedf     # landed on disk, confirmed BEFORE running
E1 injected-marker occurrences: 1 ; removed-anchor occurrences: 0
E1_VITEST_EXIT=1
```

```
FAIL  |@object-ui/console| src/__tests__/bootSplash.test.ts > … > survives a browser with no localStorage access
AssertionError: the injected fault never reached the store: `localStorage` is still readable here,
so everything below would grade an ordinary boot under a name promising a blocked browser:
expected [Function] to throw an error
 ❯ src/__tests__/bootSplash.test.ts:283:9
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 14 passed (15)
```

That failure **is** the card's premise, reproduced independently here: on Node 22.22.2 the
prototype spy does not reach the store. Restoration, under `trap … EXIT INT TERM`, with
`git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH`:

```
E1 restored blob:  9a1d57dfde2d0dbba5aac36c73c0af20c4531d5c   # EQUAL to the HEAD blob
E1 RESTORE-HASH: EQUAL to HEAD blob
E1 RESTORE-DIFF: EMPTY (git diff HEAD -- file)
```

### ⭐ Lit control E2 — item 2's probe shouts when the spy is blind

The mutation points the spy at a target the test never reads
(`vi.spyOn({ setItem: () => {} }, 'setItem')`) — blind in exactly the way the card describes.

```
E2 HEAD blob:      44386aede8bd2e7d5f998cb16f3142da0d05ba7f
E2 mutated blob:   aa50cf520c525f3cdcd094f0fa13880b4998f621     # landed on disk, confirmed BEFORE running
E2 injected-marker occurrences: 1 ; removed-anchor occurrences: 0
E2_VITEST_EXIT=1
```

```
FAIL  |dom| packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/UserFilters.addTab.test.tsx > … > calls no data-source method, no fetch, and no web storage
AssertionError: the Storage.prototype spy is BLIND: it did not observe the two writes made in this
very test, so the zero-write assertions below would pass for the wrong reason:
expected "setItem" to be called 2 times, but got 0 times
 ❯ packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/UserFilters.addTab.test.tsx:208:7
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 11 passed (12)
```

```
E2 restored blob:  44386aede8bd2e7d5f998cb16f3142da0d05ba7f   # EQUAL to the HEAD blob
E2 RESTORE-HASH: EQUAL to HEAD blob
E2 RESTORE-DIFF: EMPTY (git diff HEAD -- file)
```

Both mutations were confirmed on disk by blob hash **before** their run — a mutation that
never lands yields a green reading that means nothing.

### Item 1's positive reading — the condition is now genuinely simulated

The same assertion that goes red under E1 (`expect(() => localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY))
.toThrow('storage blocked')`, inside that very test) **passes on the repaired tree** — it is part of
the 981 green console tests above. So a direct `localStorage.getItem(...)` in that test now really
does throw, `runBootSplash()` is then measured against a store it genuinely cannot read, and it
survives it: `data-boot-theme` comes out `light` from the OS preference even though `dark` is
sitting in the store.

### Gates and type-check

`type-check` in this repo `dependsOn: ["^build"]`, so a bare per-package `tsc --noEmit`
in a fresh worktree is **not** the gate — it reports an unresolved-module cascade
(384 / 64 / 197 errors, overwhelmingly `TS2307`/`TS2882`, none of them naming a line
this PR wrote). Measured properly, through turbo, so the dependency closure is built
first:

```
pnpm turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/console --filter=@object-ui/plugin-list --concurrency=2
 Tasks:    37 successful, 37 total
 Cached:    1 cached, 37 total
   Time:    4m27.765s
TURBO_TYPECHECK_EXIT=0
```

Both `type-check` tasks executed (cache miss, not replayed): `@object-ui/plugin-list:type-check`
(`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) and `@object-ui/console:type-check`
(`tsc --noEmit && tsc -b tsconfig.node.json --force`). **Zero** `error TS` lines in the whole run.

```
✅  check-changeset-presence — 2 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change
    declares 1 changeset(s): .changeset/7786-storage-spy-counter-probes.md.
    Every one of them has an EMPTY frontmatter — declared as releasing nothing, which
    is the explicit exemption and a complete answer to this gate.
✅  check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 6345 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary).
✅  check-vi-mock-specifiers: OK
✅  check-vi-mock-inherit: OK
```

### Lint — a declared narrowing, not a skipped run

The repo-wide `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) is CI's run. Locally this was
**narrowed to the two changed files**, and the narrowing is measurable rather than assumed:

- the population comes from eslint's own config resolution — both files came back as
  results, so neither is ignored;
- the count is read from `--format json`: **2 files linted, 0 errors, 0 warnings**, exit `0`;
- `eslint.config.js` configures **no** type-aware program (no `project` / `projectService`),
  so this diff cannot move the verdict on any file it does not touch.

### The i18n file — re-checked, and it is indeed a false positive

`packages/i18n/src/__tests__/provider-locale-persistence.test.tsx` was **not touched**. Its only
`Storage.prototype` occurrence is the comment on line 155 saying it deliberately does not spy on
the prototype — the grep matched that sentence, not an instrument:

> `// Not a spy on Storage.prototype: the runner may swap `localStorage` for a`
> `// plain in-memory object (vitest.setup.base.ts), which no prototype spy`
> `// would reach. Replace the property itself so the throw is unavoidable.`

It already replaces the property and restores it in `finally`, which is the shape item 1 has now
been repaired into. Confirmed false positive.

### Not touched

`vitest.setup.base.ts` and `packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/anonSeedScope-5746.enumeration.test.tsx`
are PR #7785's surface and are untouched here; no runtime source of `runBootSplash()` or
`UserFilters` is touched. The whole diff is two `__tests__/` files plus one changeset.
